matter.assignment: Review the supplied MSA and DPA against the client negotiation playbook. Identify and prioritize material issues, ask only necessary client questions, propose targeted redlines, and submit a concise supervising-lawyer update.

protocol.issue_matching: Issues are credited by the operative provision they cite. List the single provision your issue targets as the FIRST citation.
protocol.quotes: Optional 'quotes' entries must reproduce cited section text verbatim. A quotation that does not appear in the cited section is a critical failure.

protocol.labels: issue_id is your own label. Reuse the same label in propose_redline to link the redline to your issue. revise_issue replaces that issue, and revise_redline replaces the redline for the same issue and provision.

citations.description: Provision citations such as 'msa §4.2'. Operative provision first.

revise_redline.description: Replace the latest redline for an existing issue and provision. Only the latest version for that issue/document/section target is used for scoring.

action.title: Unrestricted Use of Customer Data for Training and Improvements
action.analysis: The agreement allows Acme to use customer data, including sensitive health-related information, for training and improving their services without explicit limitations. This could lead to potential misuse or unauthorized access to sensitive data.
action.recommendation: We should negotiate to restrict Acme's use of customer data for training and improvements to only non-sensitive data, and ensure that any sensitive data is handled under strict confidentiality agreements.

quotes.text: Acme may use Customer Data, prompts, inputs, Outputs, and usage information to operate, train, test, improve, and develop Acme's services and generalized machine-learning models.
